hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.title.about: a short title for the Druse Heart request

hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.claime.about: the Vicar saying the player already has the lattice and could bind another from scrap and ash

hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.prompt.about: a player prompt for asking for the lattice that teaches a cauldron to hold more

hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.ready.about: the Vicar confirming the player fed a cauldron and took out what it set, granting the lattice, and telling them to seat it at the Rite of the First Clotting with five more offerings

hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.requir.about: the Vicar stating requirements for the lattice: proof of drawing a formation from a cauldron by hand, active blood, and reaching the third Degree

hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.title.about: a short title for the Clotting Lattice request

hemomancy.vicar.covenant.bind_throne.about: the Vicar telling the player to bind a Covenant Throne to their Fane and sit in it so the covenant has a place to hold its people

hemomancy.vicar.covenant.chamber_return.about: the Vicar telling the player to begin the Rite of the Chamber of Will on a Grand Threshold floor with an echo shard in the brazier, enter the Chamber and return safely, and explaining earlier guided visits do not count

hemomancy.vicar.covenant.complete_vigil.about: the Vicar telling the player to summon a recruited Vicar to the Fane with the ancestral ledger and keep them at a rite station through the whole Covenant Vigil, warning an interrupted vigil earns no proof

hemomancy.vicar.covenant.found_bloodline.about: the Vicar telling the player to first found their bloodline by performing the Rite of Bloodline Founding at Lesser Communion with blaze powder in the brazier, which gives the ancestral ledger, noting an unsigned ledger founds nothing

hemomancy.vicar.covenant.found_fane.about: the Vicar directing the player to perform the Rite of the Founding Fane at Grand Dominion with Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus, a Nautilus Shell in the brazier, a Bloodwell and Stakes, and to project blood into the Bloodwell personally at the fifth Degree if a Fane exists

hemomancy.vicar.covenant.perform_bloodli.about: the Vicar telling the player their bloodline and Fane are ready for the Rite of the Bloodline Covenant to become Sanctified, and that outpost specialists may be invited though the Artificer will keep serving at the outpost

hemomancy.vicar.covenant.perform_hematic.about: the Vicar telling the player that returning from the Chamber, binding the Throne and keeping the Vigil proves the Living Covenant, so they may perform the Rite of the Hematic Order

hemomancy.vicar.covenant_lore.about: the Vicar explaining that the Hematic Covenant is the whole body of rites, customs and learning governing hemomancy since the First Age, and each Degree's rite shows a practitioner what they have become

hemomancy.vicar.first_bloodcraft_reward..about: a prompt that the ledger bears all four proofs and the Vicar can grant the Second Degree

hemomancy.vicar.fungal_survey.lead.about: the Vicar telling the player the gardens grow in the Overworld's wet country where swamp, jungle or mushroom field would take hold, to survey them on foot, with no need to enter the fungal projection

hemomancy.vicar.fungal_survey.specimens.about: the Vicar telling the player to bring the Alchemist an Infected Fungus and a Puffball Fungus for inspection, and that both specimens remain with the player

hemomancy.vicar.fungal_survey.visited.about: the Vicar noting the player already walked the Overworld gardens, that the Alchemist will count the visit, and that no second trip is needed

hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.followup.lin.about: the Vicar remarking that another remnant means that road predates the outposts and does not follow their maps
the Vicar advising the player to keep evidence in the ledger since one stone shows initiative but a pattern of stones points at what lies beneath

hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.intro.line1.about: the Vicar explaining the first invitation was meant for the player alone while others lie in abandoned hermit cells, spoiled displays and stones stained by uncollected rites

hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.intro.line2.about: the Vicar challenging the player to follow a road unled, find a remnant in the wild, read what the blood kept there and report back, since what a Neophyte finds alone teaches him most

hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.line1.about: the Vicar approving that the player found a remnant without his guidance

hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.line2.about: the Vicar recording the find as a side road because a Neophyte who reads a trail unled is no longer wandering, and giving ash for the next stretch

hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.promp.about: a prompt telling the player they found a remnant unled and the Vicar will enter the evidence in the record

hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.armature_con.about: the Vicar telling the player to ask the Artificer for the Armature Consecration Kit, since the frame is the Artificer's to prepare while the consecration rite is the Vicar's to teach

the Vicar instructing the player to seat a base Armature beside a Greater Cardinal Focus on a Working floor, plant the Living Staff, offer the kit and five companion offerings at the lit brazier, and close both blood circuits

hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.degree_hint.about: the Vicar explaining that the Rite of the Bloodline Covenant remains, requiring the player to commit to a bloodline under permanent oaths to become Sanctified, and warning such bonds cannot be dissolved without cost

hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.founding_fan.about: the Vicar explaining the Rite of the Founding Fane: Sanguine Quintessence in the Cardinal Focus, a Consecrated Bloodwell as its heart, a flexible envelope boundary drawn outward by Hematic Stakes, and no building needed

hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.line1.about: the Vicar greeting an Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge, noting few hold the title and the parted veil will not close again

hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.lodge_lore.about: the Vicar explaining that the Crimson Lodge keeps the most guarded knowledge, including the link between hemomancy and the mycelial network and one organism of blood and living earth, which its Archons will not discuss openly

hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.monolith_rum.about: narration of discomfort then reverence crossing the Vicar's face as he smooths both away, followed by his saying the Lodge keeps unconfirmed ancient rumors off parchment

the Vicar admitting that ancient Harbingers may have found a way past the taught degrees, that he knows only half a story, and that he gives the player a reliquary fragment in an unfamiliar script their blood may read better

hemomancy.vicar.illuminatus.scrap_given.about: the Vicar handing over the scrap, saying he has carried it long enough and that if it means anything to the player, it was meant to reach them

hemomancy.vicar.initiate.castles_lore.about: the Vicar saying the ruined castles are older than the Order's records, that the Fargone hold them now and guard more than they use, and advising the player to go armed and collect what the stores keep

hemomancy.vicar.initiate.degree_hint.about: the Vicar explaining the next rite is the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood, a rite of shared blood proving hemomancy can serve others, and advising study of the Bloodline system first

hemomancy.vicar.initiate.fane_lore.about: the Vicar explaining the Incarnadine Fane was founded in the Second Age by the Archon Erythravane, whose rites broke those leaning on raw force and remade them as instruments of precision

hemomancy.vicar.initiate.line1.about: the Vicar greeting an Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane, noting the blood now speaks in them and the Fane recognized a quality most never develop

hemomancy.vicar.initiate.saints_lore.about: the Vicar explaining the Saints were past practitioners sealed away by their own people, that the Order inherited the tombs, that a defeated Saint returns dormant to its sarcophagus, that outer halls are open but a ward guards deeper, and that Hallowed Residuum from the Centrifuge yields Canon Memories

hemomancy.vicar.item_hint.about: the Vicar asking the player what they have brought and offering to speak only where doctrine or history gives him warrant

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.blood_struc.about: the Vicar explaining that a blood-structure plan lays out blocks so that once complete, Blood Projection can persuade the form into work
the Vicar telling the player to build the structure exactly and project at the proper point, which wakes it without a separate blood key

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line1.about: the Vicar remarking that the Order has kept records in books for generations, and a blank one in attentive hands becomes worth reading

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.book.line2.about: the Vicar noting that the Order's lasting work came from people who wrote clear instructions for those who followed

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.brine_seale.about: the Vicar identifying a sealed letter of introduction, sealed with Sunburst crust, carried by a crew that drowned trying to reach the Brined Court
the Vicar calling the drowned envoys Votaries, saying he would not have the player finish their errand blind, and that a Voyager can say where the Court keeps its door

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.dendritic_d.about: the Vicar describing the Dendritic Distributor as a nervous archive for rehearsed blood-memory patterns that holds a working arrangement but needs a mind to choose it well
the Vicar advising the player to name each pattern carefully since combat, travel, rites and fane work ask different reflexes

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.dragon_egg..about: the Vicar noting that some Lodge naturalists treat a Dragon Egg's compressed vitality as evidence for broader theories of living potential
the Vicar dismissing those theories as learned speculation with no place in settled Covenant cosmology and no degree rite asking for one

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.earthen_vei.about: the Vicar describing the Earthen Vein as a grown living conduit that, placed in sequence, forms a network carrying blood from source to destination
the Vicar saying a developed Harbinger workshop runs on veins and, though avoidable early, the player will want what they carry once the Loom is regular work

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.enchanted_b.about: the Vicar comparing an enchanted book's arcane inscription to a sanguine memory crystal, differing in method but both keeping knowledge in a form another can take up

the Vicar noting arcane inscription and memory weaving attack the same problem from opposite sides, and that higher-Degree practitioners have recorded unfinished links between enchantment schools and tendency affinities

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hallowed_re.about: the Vicar explaining that Hallowed Residuum is a Saint's concentrated legacy, drawn peacefully if the player's alignment suits the Saint, but a rejecting Saint wakes and must be fought

the Vicar explaining that a peaceful sample becomes Residuum in the Vial Centrifuge while a Saint driven back into its tomb gives it up directly, then it goes to the Loom for Canon Memory work beside Gardens memory of that Saint

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.heart_of_th.about: the Vicar remarking that the Heart of the Sea carries a deep-water resonance some find suggestive
the Vicar noting some see kinship between water and blood in it, others only liturgical metaphor, and the Heart itself settles nothing

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.hematic_mem.about: the Vicar explaining that a Hematic Memory carries one deliberate manipulation lesson that becomes part of the player's known practice when used
the Vicar noting that the Mnemonic Reliquary later arranges active lessons, but neither crystal nor Reliquary can work a personal manipulation into a bloodline

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.iron_brazie.about: the Vicar explaining that the Iron Brazier holds rite fire feeding a Cardinal Rite, may stand on the floor, wall or ceiling, and any lit Brazier inside the cube rising from a rite's floor answers that rite
the Vicar explaining a Living Weapon Graft can burn in the Brazier by holding the Living Staff and drawing with Blood Absorption, and the rite consumes the graft only if the memory takes

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.minecraft_r.about: the Vicar saying an old instrument of measure, direction or return is respected without pretending every relic belongs to the Order
the Vicar saying a relic's meaning comes from the work done around it, with age the lesser part

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mnemonic_bl.about: the Vicar explaining that a blank mnemonic blueprint takes only a properly learned rite or blood structure
the Vicar remarking that few practitioners of the player's high Degree need a mnemonic blueprint so it is rare to see one
the Vicar warning that the upper rites' language is precise for a reason and a missed word may break the rite
the Vicar explaining that a mnemonic blueprint's imprints each describe a rite or blood structure, including what it demands and proves
the Vicar urging study of the blueprint since it points to what lies next, as the Order does not advance anyone who has not understood the work
the Vicar noting a mnemonic blueprint for a middle-Degree structure, where the Order's demands grow less forgiving
the Vicar saying the blueprint gives only the outline and the player's blood must supply the rest
the Vicar explaining the blueprint holds the spatial memory of a Cardinal Rite and guides building, but the rite's authority comes from the rite itself
the Vicar explaining the blueprint remembers a blood structure and shows its form, but Blood Projection must still make it answer

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mnemonic_re.about: the Vicar explaining the Mnemonic Reliquary arranges which known bodily and willed memories stand readiest to hand
the Vicar clarifying the Reliquary changes only readiness; learning stays in the memory and the covenant stays in the bloodline

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.monolith.li.about: the Vicar saying the Sanguine Monolith belongs to the upper Degrees and offers practitioners who have come far enough what is older than doctrine
the Vicar admitting that in the higher degrees the Monolith becomes the player's main guide since his counsel runs out around degree five

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.mortal_disp.about: the Vicar explaining a Mortal Display is a Hermit's offered heart sustained at the center of the temple built for their final vigil
the Vicar explaining that claiming the heart is a personal invitation, completing the initiating rite ends the giver's vigil, and it holds no organ echo because it was only meant to be passed on

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.nether_star.about: the Vicar describing a Nether Star as concentrated Wither energy, real in power but without direction or purpose
the Vicar saying raw power only goes so far uncultivated, the Order grows purpose inside such force, and asking the player to bring something that remembers what it is

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.potion.line.about: the Vicar describing a common alchemical potion as old craft distilling water and herbs into blunt metabolic effects that serve most of the world well enough
the Vicar comparing the potion to a candle beside a fire that knows where it burns, both giving light but only the fire answering intention

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.qliphoth.li.about: the Vicar asking where the player got a Qliphoth Pome, saying it belongs to the Archon's private revelation and not ordinary practice
the Vicar saying nine Pomes from one Bloom, all eaten, complete Communion and the ninth tears the Fungal Spine free, which no one below that threshold should be taught as ordinary practice

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.qliphoth.se.about: the Vicar saying the record of the Qliphoth Pome is sealed above the player's Degree, he will not guess, and the player should not eat it

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.salt_staine.about: the Vicar reading a nearly illegible voyager log whose order of names (watch lead, alchemist, diver, mnemonist) shows they sailed as a covenant with work to do
the Vicar saying the wreck kept both the crew's failures and their care, and the player should read both

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.sanguine_co.about: the Vicar explaining a cauldron that has drunk the player's blood keeps it and slowly sets it into formation, and the lesson counts only for whoever fed it and drew the result by hand

the Vicar telling the player that after practice they should take the Condenser to a Working floor, where the Clotting Lattice makes it hold more and set faster and the Druse Heart lines it in crystal

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scar_blank..about: the Vicar describing a blank Scar waiting for a route to be carved at the Cerebral Scarring Station
the Vicar explaining that a carved Scar is burned into memory at an Iron Brazier and later arrangements are copied through the Mason's Effigy, never worn from the pack
the Vicar telling the player blank scar plates are for the fourth Degree and to attend to the work in front of them until then

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scar_patter.about: the Vicar describing unwritten motif paper that the Vein-Mason would call a promise not yet made
the Vicar describing a prepared scar loadout with known routes arranged at the Mason's Effigy and made active at the Iron Brazier
the Vicar describing a scar template as instruction for carving one route before it is burned into memory

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.scrying_pod.about: the Vicar explaining the Scrying Podium reads the practitioner's blood and shows the tendency distribution of dominant, latent and current balance
the Vicar advising use of the Podium early while the path forms and again when a rite or memory weave needs a balance, noting that interpreting the readout is the player's own judgment

hemomancy.vicar.item_inquiry.unknown.about: the Vicar saying there is nothing in the record about the item so he will not guess

hemomancy.vicar.masons_respite.prompt.about: the Vicar saying the player's next instruction cannot be given at this outpost and offering to mark the road to Masons Respite where the Vein-Mason waits

hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.absorption_hint.about: the Vicar explaining that Blood Absorption toward a living creature or blood reservoir is counted by the ledger, flask or passive blood is not, and 500 mL total is needed

hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.crafting_hint.about: the Vicar telling a Neophyte to craft Foul Paste from Nether Wart, gunpowder and bone meal, smelt it into Befouling Ash, ask for a Mnemonic Blueprint, build either pattern, hold its catalyst offhand, and project blood into the center

hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint.about: the Vicar listing the four proofs for the Second Degree, in any order: absorb 500 mL, condense a Sanguine Formation in a cauldron, project Venous Stone, craft a Liber Sanguinium or Hematic Iron Block with a blood formation, then bring him the ledger

hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.degree_hint.ass.about: the Vicar adding that after the Second Degree is granted the Alchemist will teach separation and the Ghastly Alembic

hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.first_bloodcraf.about: the Vicar telling the player they already had the Order's provision and should use those materials rather than let them pile up
the Vicar approving the player's answers to the first four lessons, granting the Second Degree, and sending them to the Alchemist for separation and distillation

the Vicar refusing the reward until the ledger shows all four proofs, in any order, and reminding the player that for the cauldron they must project their own blood into it and collect the Sanguine Formation themselves

hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line1.about: narration of the Vicar inclining his head in formal acknowledgment

hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.line2.about: the Vicar greeting a Neophyte of the Crimson Veil, saying the first threshold is behind them and the road is long and discipline will be asked before revelation

hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.projection_hint.about: the Vicar explaining two lessons with two targets: blood poured into an empty cauldron eventually crystallizes into a Sanguine Formation the player must take out, blood poured into ordinary stone stains it to Venous Stone

hemomancy.vicar.purifying.chosen_path.about: the Vicar, narrated closing his eyes, telling the player who chose the Unstained path that the Order will not mourn them, their blood will find a worthier vessel, and they must leave the Outpost before the path takes them somewhere the Order cannot follow

hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line1.about: narration of the Vicar's composure breaking as his face shows grief and contempt together

hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line2.about: the Vicar saying he can feel the Unstained path starving the player's blood and peeling away granted power, and every rite and Degree earned beginning to come apart

hemomancy.vicar.purifying.line3.about: the Vicar asking if the player understands what they throw away, warning that blood remembers a recantation, the Covenant's gifts weaken with each step, and the power is already slipping and will not wait

hemomancy.vicar.purifying.power_warning.about: the Vicar telling the player who goes on anyway that their hemomantic strength fades daily, manipulations dulling and tendencies quieting, that the Order does not reach out twice, and to return while they still can

hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.degree_hint.about: the Vicar explaining one rite remains, the Rite of the Hematic Order, the hardest, asking what the player is willing to give of their blood and warning it has claimed the unprepared

hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.hematic_order.about: the Vicar explaining the Hematic Order tops the Covenant's hierarchy as a state the blood itself must recognize, that the founders believed initiated blood becomes indistinguishable from the world's, and the last rite confirms rather than grants Archon

hemomancy.vicar.sanctified.line1.about: the Vicar greeting a Sanctified player, saying the Bloodline Covenant has woven them into the Order's living body as a node in a greater network

hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.harbinger_lo.about: the Vicar explaining that Harbingers seek revelation not violence, hold blood as the first language of existence, and that the Covenant keeps the knowledge letting its speakers rise past ordinary limits

hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line1.about: narration of a figure in sweeping ceremonial vestments watching the player with hands folded inside wide sleeves

hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.line2.about: the Vicar introducing himself as the Harbinger Vicar, keeper of the Covenant's doctrine, history and truths, telling an uninitiated wanderer they still deserve to know where they stand

hemomancy.vicar.uninitiated.outpost_lore.about: the Vicar explaining the Outpost is a waystation in the Harbinger network beyond the Blood Temples where practitioners resupply, learn and are guided, with the Alchemist tending machines and himself doctrine

hemomancy.vicar.votary.degree_hint.about: the Vicar explaining the Alchemist holds the two proofs for this stage, an assigned separation and a Ghastly Alembic distillation, after which the player asks for Concentrated Blood, injects it, sleeps and wakes at the third Degree

hemomancy.vicar.votary.line1.about: the Vicar greeting a Votary of the Hematic Covenant, noting their tendencies crystallize and their blood knows what it wants, and asking whether they can tell what it asks for

hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.floor.about: the Vicar explaining the Rite of the Rooted Vein needs a Dominion floor: a Lesser square of deepslate tiles or bricks with eight Chiseled Hematic Iron blocks around a Cardinal Focus, no copper because it is the Unstained metal, with making done on the Working floor

hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.offer.about: the Vicar instructing the player to keep the block above the Focus clear, set one Blood Rock in an Iron Brazier on a floor socket and light it with Blood Projection, leave the Focus's medium slot empty, and noting no helper is needed

hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.recov.about: the Vicar explaining the Focus becomes Venous Stone with a permanent Earthen Vein on completion, and that cancelling before then needs Blood Absorption held on the planted Staff, with paid blood and consumed offerings lost but untouched offerings remaining

hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.staff.about: the Vicar instructing the player to use the Living Staff on the Focus, feed the four anchors with Blood Projection, project into the daemon to seal the rite, stay inside the boundary, noting the rite answers only by degree and active blood

hemomancy.vicar.votary.tendency_lore.about: the Vicar listing the eight blood tendencies (Animus, Flammeus, Ductilis, Lux, Mortem, Congeatio, Ferric, Tenebris) and their common enzyme names (Vivacious, Fervent, Neurotic, Incandescent, Ruinous, Frigid, Ferric, Umbral)

hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.bea.about: the Vicar giving the coordinates (two numbers fill in) of a Voyager vessel in the Overworld and telling the player to find the crew and record an observation by asking about their work, as knowing the location alone does not count
the Vicar saying the vessel charts are in use and asking the player to request the bearing again shortly
the Vicar saying the charts show no Voyager vessel in the waters searched, so the player should ask at another Overworld outpost or find a Voyager at an Erythrocoral Reef
the Vicar saying he will search the vessel charts while the player works in the Overworld and send the bearing when a vessel turns up, with the player asking again if they leave first
the Vicar saying the world's charts give no vessel routes, so the player must find a Voyager at an Erythrocoral Reef themselves

hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.lea.about: the Vicar telling the player to look for the Erythrocoral Reef in deep warm seas where active Voyager vessels work, to ask for a vessel bearing first, and to speak with a Voyager and bring back one observation of the crew's work

hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.obs.about: the Vicar noting the player already spoke with a Voyager in the reef waters, asking what they saw, and saying they need not sail out again

hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.rec.about: system narration that the Vicar records the player's Voyager observation and files it with the field reports

hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.rep.about: a prompt for the player to report the reef observation they recorded with the Voyager

hemomancy.vicar.voyager_introduction.tas.about: the Vicar clarifying that a reef or active vessel suffices and he does not want a whale, ambergris or any trophy
